value.rationale: The exact first point at which fixed-size constraints make static shattering underestimate adversarial online mistakes has mathematical motivation in same-cluster learning with prescribed balanced group sizes. The minimal local 2+3 structure yields an exact unbounded separation in a natural independent-block family, differentiating it sharply from the refinement-closed case. The value is this boundary/classification and its fixed-group amplification, not mere numerical verification or code availability.
